international.title: Shabana Mahmood pledges to tackle ‘corrosive and growing perception of two-tier policing’ – UK politics live
international.summary: Home secretary to give speech to National Police Chiefs’ Council addressing concerns that officers treats groups differently David Lammy , the former foreign secretary and former deputy PM, has used an article in the Times to say that Andy Burnham should proposing rejoining the EU in the next Labour manifesto. He says: Burnham has to show how joining the EU passes the Makerfield test . I believe to do that it should answer three questions. What will deliver the most growth? What will deliver the most security? And what will help prevent uncontrolled irregular migration? The customs union doesn’t deliver major growth on its own. The single market without EU membership gives Britain economic growth but with little influence over the rules we follow. Only membership answers all three questions. On migration, it would put Britain back inside the EU’s asylum returns system, giving us access to the tools we lost in 2020 and have only been rebuilding piecemeal ever since. The ability for Brits to live and work in Europe and Europeans to live and work in Britain with free movement would return. But I believe, like Ireland, we can remain outside Schengen, and, like Sweden, we can stay out of the eurozone. Continue reading...
